reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Handwritten on the newer 'Utah County - HEART of UTAH' letterhead version of the legacy form (title is the shorter 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES'; side rail 'COUNTY Commission CANDIDATES'; page 2 carries the header '2016 County Commission Candidate'). The contribution figure's second digit is written ambiguously between 0 and 9 in several cells; read as 20,644 at medium confidence. Cents are written as a raised superscript ('10,453' with a small '20'); transcribed in decimal form. Line 3 is a bare zero followed by the filer's dash. Line 6 is written with an unclosed leading parenthesis, '(10,453.20', reproduced as written. Line 7 has a stray comma-like mark before the figure. DATE: the summary page's Date of Report box reads '21 June 2016' clearly and is used here; the cover's signature date is written less clearly and reads like '20 June 2016' - the clerk received stamp is JUN 21 AM 10:58. Neither amendment box is marked, so is_amendment is left empty.
